chunks: And from his sayings (peace be upon him)
And that was when Sa'id ibn al-'As deprived him of his right

key_terms.حَقَّهُ: His right, referring to the due or entitlement of Imam Ali
key_terms.سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْعَاصِ: Sa'id ibn al-'As, a Umayyad governor and relative of the Prophet

ai.seo_question: Who deprived Imam Ali of his right according to this narration in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This narration highlights the political tension during the Umayyad ascendancy, where Sa'id ibn al-'As, acting as a key administrator under the Caliphs, withheld Imam Ali's (AS) financial rights, symbolizing the broader marginalization of the Ahl al-Bayt. It provides crucial historical context for understanding the economic and political grievances that fueled the rivalry between the Umayyads and the Imams, as recorded by Sharif al-Radi in his compilation of sermons, letters, and sayings.
